choices.help: The creator's default (TUNE=speed): fast mode, not bit-identical to the exact model (relaxed draft acceptance, 4 routed experts a decode step, an MXFP8 decode head) with gr8's v2 prefill stack, 32 chats at once, each up to 327,680 tokens (prompt and reply). The creator measured at least 3.25 GiB free a box under load.
choices.label: Speed

choices.help: Fast mode with one chat up to 1,048,576 tokens (TUNE=context), 16 chats at once, gr8's older prefill path. The creator measured 8.7-9.4 GiB free a box at ready and, on an earlier build, at least 2.69 GiB while three 1M chats ran.
choices.label: Long context

choices.help: The exact model's output (TUNE=quality, gr8's EXACT=1 and older prefill path), 5 chats at once, each up to 262,144 tokens. Not measured by the creator on this image's 48-row engine build.
choices.label: Quality

options.help: What to prioritize (the creator's TUNE). It sets fast mode or the exact model, the number of chats at once and the longest chat; every chat slot gets its full KV at boot.
options.label: Priority
options.name: tune

choices.help: The loader keeps the tensors it computes at load (about 80 GB a box, up to about 160 GB once a second key exists) in the writable cache and reads them back on the next boot with the same key (the creator's default).
choices.label: On

choices.help: Every boot computes the loader's tensors again; no gen cache on disk.
choices.label: Off

options.help: gr8's loader gen cache (GR8_GEN_CACHE): a faster later boot for about 80 GB of disk a box. A new image, a change between quality and speed or context, or another rank order writes a new key.
options.label: Load cache
options.name: gen-cache
